text:
# Close wrap, Tue 2026-10-27

1. **Indexes:** S&P +0.57% to 7,720.63, Nasdaq +1.14% to 26,467.06, Dow flat at 52,364.02. Tech led, energy worst as crude eased on Middle East peace talks; most S&P stocks fell ([Reuters via FN](https://financialnewsletter.com/wall-street-rises-on-4/); [AP](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-ai-earnings-oil-e11a2240fc3283c4507d44b9833f30a2)). AI infra rallied on Anthropic's IPO filing and $63B Broadcom chip financing: NBIS +11%, WDC and BE +8% ([CNBC midday](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/27/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-midday-sofi-pnr-rcl-jblu.html)).
2. **Movers:** BA −9.7% (wider loss), XYL −12.4% (guide cut), SHW −2.3% ([Reuters via FN](https://financialnewsletter.com/wall-street-rises-on-4/)). RCL +~8%, UPS +3%, PYPL +2%, SOFI +15% (guide raised), PNR closed +12.8% at $62.30 on raised sales guide, JBLU +20% ([CNBC midday](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/27/stocks-making-the-biggest-moves-midday-sofi-pnr-rcl-jblu.html); [Exa PNR](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/PNR)). NVDA +1%, META −0.8% on the $3B stake.
3. **After hours:** V beat (adj EPS $3.48, rev $12.1B +13%, dividend +16%) but −1.6% to ~$395 ([StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/news/V/visa-fiscal-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2026-financial-ca0jbsndz69c.html); [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/V/)). HOOD missed (EPS $0.51 vs $0.56, rev $1.42B) −3.6% ([TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/robinhood-stock-hood-slips-after-0-51-eps-figure-misses-estimates); [Public](https://public.com/stocks/hood/after-hours)). STX beat and guided Q2 rev $4.8B vs $4.53B est., yet initially −7% ([24/7 Wall St](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/27/live-will-seagate-technology-smash-q1-earnings-tonight-after-5-intraday-jump/)).
4. **Tomorrow:** FOMC 2 PM (hold expected); MSFT, GOOGL, NOW, TMUS after close. Our oil longs (XLE/SLB/HAL) are exposed if peace talks progress.

Signals: added BA, XYL, HOOD avoids; dropped expired SPCX; cleared today's events.

## Swing ideas
- **PNR** long, low. Beat and raised FY sales guide, closed near high ($62.30 vs $62.66). Risk: +12.8% gap can fade; water peer XYL just cut.
- **SOFI** long, low. FY revenue guide raised to $5.04B above consensus. Risk: +15% gap fades; credit-sensitive lender.
